However, while Belfort and his cronies partake in a hedonistic brew of sex, drugs and thrills, the SEC and the FBI close in on his empire of excess. (Comedy drama, Biography) - 2013

movies.us.title: The Wolf of Wall Street
movies.us.description: In 1987, Jordan Belfort takes an entry-level job at a Wall Street brokerage firm. By the early 1990s, while still in his 20s, Belfort founds his own firm, Stratton Oakmont. Together with his trusted lieutenant and a merry band of brokers, Belfort makes a huge fortune by defrauding wealthy investors out of millions. However, while Belfort and his cronies partake in a hedonistic brew of sex, drugs and thrills, the SEC and the FBI close in on his empire of excess. (Comedy drama, Biography) - 2013

movies.us.title: Titanic
movies.us.description: Two young lovers from different backgrounds meet and fall in love on the ill-fated maiden voyage of the unsinkable R.M.S. Titanic. (Historical drama, Romance) - 1997

showtimeshowcase.us.title: The Saint
showtimeshowcase.us.description: A clever thief who is known as the master of creating false identities using the names of Catholic saints, is hired by the Russian Mafia for his next mission. But things get complicated when he falls for Emma Russel, the scientist. (Action) - 1997

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Event Horizon
showtimeshowcase.us.description: A spaceship missing for seven years finally re-emerges and sends out a distress signal. But when a team is sent out to investigate, they discover that something sinister has taken over the craft. (Science fiction, Horror) - 1997

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Phantoms
showtimeshowcase.us.description: The resort town of Snowfield, Colo., is under attack by an evil spirit that almost wipes out the entire population, possessing a number of those it kills. As the locals continue to fall victim to the demonic presence, it's up to Sheriff Bryce Hammond (Ben Affleck) to lead the response. He's helped by FBI-employed academic Dr. Timothy Flyte (Peter O'Toole), Deputy Stu Wargle (Liev Schreiber), local doctor Jennifer Pailey (Joanna Going) and her visiting sister, Lisa (Rose McGowan). (Horror) - 1998

showtimeextreme.us.title: Pulp Fiction
showtimeextreme.us.description: Vincent Vega and Jules Winnfield are hitmen with a penchant for philosophical discussions. In this ultra-hip, multi-strand crime movie, their storyline is interwoven with those of their boss, gangster Marsellus Wallace; his actress wife, Mia; struggling boxer Butch Coolidge; master fixer The Wolf and a nervous pair of armed robbers, Pumpkin and Honey Bunny. (Crime drama, Dark comedy) - 1994

showtimeextreme.us.title: 68 Kill
showtimeextreme.us.description: Trailer-dwelling, sewage-pumping Chip may not lead the most glamorous life, but he's got one thing going for him: he's head over heels infatuated with his girlfriend, Liza. So when she proposes a plot to steal $68,000, he goes along with the plan. But when what was supposed to be a simple heist turns into an off-the-rails, blood-spattered crime spree, Chip learns the hard way just how deranged the love of his life really is. (Comedy, Crime drama, Romance, Thriller) - 2017

showtimeextreme.us.title: The Death of Stalin
showtimeextreme.us.description: When tyrannical dictator Joseph Stalin dies in 1953, his parasitic cronies square off in a frantic power struggle to become the next Soviet leader. Among the contenders are the dweebish Georgy Malenkov, the wily Nikita Khrushchev and Lavrentiy Beria -- the sadistic secret police chief. As they bumble, brawl and back-stab their way to the top, the question remains -- just who is running the government? (Dark comedy, Historical drama) - 2017

showtimewomen.us.title: Sliver
showtimewomen.us.description: Well-to-do book editor Carly Norris (Sharon Stone) moves into a luxury apartment building before learning that a number of female tenants have been dying in grisly ways, allegedly at the hands of a serial killer. Soon, Norris becomes romantically involved with one of the prime suspects, building owner Zeke Hawkins (William Baldwin). The other suspect is her neighbor, writer Jack Landsford (Tom Berenger). Unsure of whom to trust, Norris must uncover the truth before she is the next victim. (Thriller) - 1993

showtimewomen.us.title: Body Cam
showtimewomen.us.description: While investigating the murder of a fellow officer, veteran Renee Lomito discovers a mysterious figure in the body cam footage. Haunted by visions of the event, she suspects something supernatural is targeting the cops in her unit. Now, in a race against time to find the one person who can stop these killings, Renee uncovers a sinister secret among the police force surrounding the shooting and cover-up of an unarmed youth. (Horror, Thriller) - 2020

showtimewomen.us.title: Vindicta
showtimewomen.us.description: When a city is terrorized by a sadistic serial killer, a seasoned detective and a newly recruited paramedic are forced into a deadly game of vengeance, only to discover the key to stopping the bloodshed lies in unlocking the truth of their own pasts. (Thriller) - 2023

skykids.uk.title: Boosnoo! Mashups
skykids.uk.description: Sleepy: BooSnoo! visits all the relaxing and calming moments guaranteed to get you ready for dreamtime. (S2, ep 6)

skykids.uk.title: Miffy And Friends
skykids.uk.description: Mayor Miffy: Miffy goes to work with her mum and learns what it means to be a mayor. She discovers the importance of helping others and working together. (S1, ep 5)

skykids.uk.title: Miffy And Friends
skykids.uk.description: Snuffy Plays Ball: Miffy and Snuffy head to the park to play and find their friends playing football. It turns out Snuffy is very good at scoring goals! (S1, ep 6)

skysport1.nz.description: The last week of the NPC regular season sees one last Shield Challenge as the Counties Manukau Steelers host Hawke's Bay in Pukekohe. Ahead of this, we go back to a classic game between the two at McLean Park in 2006. (Episode)

skysport1.nz.title: Forever Auckland FC - The Dating Game
skysport1.nz.description: Captain Hiroki Sakai sets the standard both on and off the pitch, but Callan Elliot is eager to claim his right-back spot. AFC's newest star, Lachie Brook, takes to the field after a heartbreaking loss. (Episode)

skysport1.nz.title: Forever Auckland FC - You Can't Make This Stuff Up
skysport1.nz.description: Oli Sail gets a chance to prove himself after two mistakes cost Michael Woud his spot. However, a devastating injury cuts Oli's season short, and Michael is thrust back into the spotlight. (Episode)

skysport2.nz.description: Coverage from Round 1 of the Gallagher Premiership between the Sales Sharks and Bristol Bears at CorpAcq Stadium, Manchester. (Episode)

skysport2.nz.description: Highlights of the first One Day International between India and West Indies at the Greenfield International Stadium, Thiruvananthapuram. (Episode)

screenpixaction.us.title: Incident in an Alley
screenpixaction.us.description: A policeman (Chris Warfield) hears a woman scream, fires his gun and stands trial for killing a boy. (Crime drama) - 1962

screenpixaction.us.title: The Killer Elite
screenpixaction.us.description: Friends George Hansen (Robert Duvall) and Mike Locken (James Caan) are hit men who do contract jobs for a company called Com-Teg, associated with the CIA. But, when George gets a better offer from the competition, he turns on Mike, breaking his elbow and shoulder. It takes Mike a long time and a lot of physical therapy to get back on the job, but he does -- and coincidentally finds himself protecting a client whom Hansen and his gang are simultaneously being paid to assassinate. (Action) - 1975

screenpixaction.us.title: The Nun and the Sergeant
screenpixaction.us.description: A Marine (Robert Webber) leads misfits on a mission in Korea with a nun (Anna Sten) and Asian schoolgirls for company. (War) - 1962

screenpix.us.title: Salt and Pepper
screenpix.us.description: Christopher Pepper (Peter Lawford) and Charles Salt (Sammy Davis Jr.) are hip Soho nightclub owners enjoying the good life -- until a secret agent turns up dead in their club. They find her diary and, pursuing the case on their own, discover a sinister plot to overthrow the British government, masterminded by a certain Col. Woodstock (John Le Mesurier). Salt and Pepper have a tough time getting anyone to believe their story until Col. Balsom (Ernest Clark) of MI5 hires them to foil the plot. (Comedy) - 1968

screenpix.us.title: Kiss Me, Stupid
screenpix.us.description: When popular singer Dino (Dean Martin) stops for gas in a small town near Las Vegas, mechanic Barney (Cliff Osmond) disables his car. Barney, who writes songs with local teacher Orville (Ray Walston), wants Dino to sing some of their compositions. Orville invites Dino over, but sends his wife, Zelda (Felicia Farr), away so Dino can't hit on her. He then hires prostitute Polly (Kim Novak) to play his wife. Meanwhile, Zelda goes to a bar, where she gets drunk and eventually meets a lonely Dino. (Romantic comedy) - 1964

screenpix.us.title: The Children's Hour
screenpix.us.description: Longtime friends Martha (Shirley MacLaine) and Karen (Audrey Hepburn) run a boarding school for girls. When an unruly child, Mary (Karen Balkin), is punished for lying, she concocts a story that Karen and Martha are having a lesbian relationship. When the story spreads, parents withdraw their children from the school. The women's lawsuit for libel hits many snags when they lack witnesses to speak for them. All the stress adversely affects Karen's engagement to Joe Cardin (James Garner). (Drama, LGBTQ) - 1961

skysport3.nz.title: Between Two Posts
skysport3.nz.description: TUE 29 SEP Not your typical rugby show as Sean, Morgs and Hoilesy return with sharp analysis, big stories and plenty of banter as they break down each weekend’s rugby action, joined by special guests for insights on and off the field. (Episode)

skysport4.nz.description: TUE 29 SEP - Yvonne Sampson and Jake Duke sit down with rugby league’s biggest names for revealing conversations that uncover the game’s driving stories. (Episode)

skysport4.nz.title: NRL Try Time
skysport4.nz.description: TUE 29 SEP - Missed the latest NRL action? Lara Pitt showcases the best tries from latest round of the NRL Telstra Premiership in a jam-packed hour. (Episode)

skysport4.nz.title: The Crowd Goes Wild
skysport4.nz.description: MON 28 SEP- Join the team for an alternative dose of sports news, delivering the best (and worst) sporting moments the only way they know how, with a little cheek! (Episode)

skysport5.nz.description: TUE 29th SEP - Late Braking, the new Sky Sport motorsport show with Greg Murphy, brings fans the comments, controversies and opinions from drivers and experts on what happened, what's happening, and the excuses for why it all went wrong! (Episode)

skysport5.nz.description: Coverage from Australia taking on South Africa at Optus Stadium, Perth. (Episode)

skysport7.nz.description: Coverage of AFL Women's Round 7 as the Gold Coast SUNS take on St Kilda at People First Stadium, Gold Coast. (Episode)

skyscifi.uk.title: Most Haunted - Tretower Court and Castle
skyscifi.uk.description: Yvette Fielding and the team visit Tretower court and castle in Wales, which is reportedly inhabited by the ghost of a white lady thought to be the wife of Roger Vaughan who built Tretower Court in the 1400s. (Documentary, Paranormal, Reality) - 2005

skyscifi.uk.title: Most Haunted - Hollywood Legion
skyscifi.uk.description: The team visit the American Legion in Hollywood, once a favourite haunt for military and Hollywood stars. Derek picks up on a couple of celebs in the bar and gets in touch with an old custodian who died in the building. (Documentary, Paranormal, Reality) - 2005

showtimenext.us.title: Fight or Flight
showtimenext.us.description: A mercenary takes on the job of tracking a high-value asset known only as "The Ghost" on an international flight. Realizing the plane is filled with assassins assigned to kill them both, the pair must work together in a fight for their lives. (Action, Comedy) - 2024

showtimenext.us.title: The Seven Five
showtimenext.us.description: Former NYPD officer Michael Dowd tells how he and his partner committed a long list of crimes, including running their own cocaine ring, while on the job in the 1980s and early '90s. (Documentary, Biography) - 2014

showtimenext.us.title: The Kid
showtimenext.us.description: A young boxer who hopes to become a champion keeps his activities a secret from his disapproving parents. (Drama) - 1997

sbssydney.au.title: Plat Du Tour

sbssydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
sbssydney.au.description: S8 E59 True Blue Tastes Dessert dynamo Terri Mercieca and food historian Dr. Lauren Samuelsson join Adam to advance Australian fare with some true blue tastes.

sbssydney.au.title: Britain's Most Luxurious Train Journeys
sbssydney.au.description: S1 E4 Snowdonia It's elegance all the way for guests aboard the majestic Statesman train, travelling to spectacular Snowdonia in North Wales.

showtime2west.us.title: Vicious
showtime2west.us.description: A strange ritual soon unravels into a waking nightmare when a woman receives a mysterious box that comes with instructions to place three things inside: something you need, something you hate, and something you love.

showtime2west.us.title: Godzilla
showtime2west.us.description: Godzilla, King of the Monsters, arises to combat massive, malevolent foes that have been feeding on a nuclear plant's reactors and now threaten mankind with total annihilation.

showtime2west.us.title: Scream 4
showtime2west.us.description: The Ghostface Killer returns with a vengeance when self-help author Sidney Prescott arrives in Woodsboro on the last stop of her book tour.

showtimefamily.us.title: The Brothers Grimm
showtimefamily.us.description: Itinerant con men (Matt Damon, Heath Ledger) become caught in a real fairy tale after several maidens disappear in an enchanted forest.

showtimefamily.us.title: Hitsville: The Making of Motown
showtimefamily.us.description: Motown Records becomes the most successful label of all time after its formation in 1958 Detroit amid racial tension and the burgeoning civil rights movement.

showtimefamily.us.title: Turtle Power: The Definitive History of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
showtimefamily.us.description: The release of Kevin Eastman and Peter Laird's groundbreaking comic in 1984 leads to a worldwide phenomenon.

skyselect.uk.title: Redux Redux (2025)
skyselect.uk.description: A distraught woman travels through parallel universes to kill her daughter's murderer over and over again. With each death, she grows more and more addicted to revenge, putting her own humanity in jeopardy. (Science fiction / Thriller) - 2025

skyselect.uk.title: Black Bag (2025)
skyselect.uk.description: When his beloved wife, Kathryn, is suspected of betraying the nation, intelligence agent George Woodhouse faces the ultimate test -- loyalty to his marriage or his country. (Drama / Thriller) - 2025

skyselect.uk.title: Carolina Caroline (2025)
skyselect.uk.description: A young woman joins a charming con man on the run, leaving a trail of crime and passion as they hustle through the Southeast in search of her estranged mother. (Crime drama / Romance / Thriller) - 2025

showtime.us.title: Cheech & Chong Still Smokin'
showtime.us.description: When Cheech and Chong wind up in Amsterdam, they decide to organize a show in order to help out a flailing film festival. (Movies, Comedy) - 1983

showtime.us.title: Afflicted
showtime.us.description: Two friends' tour of Europe takes a dark turn when one of them contracts a mysterious illness. They race to find out what it is and how to cure it before the sickness consumes him completely. (Movies, Horror) - 2013

showtime.us.title: Wes Craven Presents: Dracula 2000
showtime.us.description: A London antiques dealer (Christopher Plummer) travels to New Orleans to save his estranged daughter from his nemesis, Count Dracula (Gerard Butler). (Movies, Horror) - 2000

screenpixvoices.us.title: Article 99
screenpixvoices.us.description: Dr. Richard Sturgess (Ray Liotta) leads a team of compassionate doctors at a veteran's hospital. Along with Drs. Morgan (Kiefer Sutherland), Handleman (Forest Whitaker) and Van Dorn (Lea Thompson), he fights to deliver adequate care to needy veterans in the face of funding cuts and a corrupt administration. To succeed, the staff may have to bend the rules and circumvent the villainous Article 99, a bureaucratic loophole that prevents veterans from receiving the benefits they deserve. (Drama) - 1992

screenpixvoices.us.title: Cotton Comes to Harlem
screenpixvoices.us.description: Harlem's African-American population is being ripped off by the Rev. Deke O'Malley (Calvin Lockhart), who dishonestly claims that small donations will secure parcels of land in Africa. When New York City police officers Gravedigger Jones (Godfrey Cambridge) and Coffin Ed Johnson (Raymond St. Jacques) look into O'Malley's scam, they learn that the cash is being smuggled inside a bale of cotton. But the police, O'Malley and lots of others find themselves scrambling when the money goes missing. (Comedy drama) - 1970

screenpixvoices.us.title: The Wild Pair
screenpixvoices.us.description: An FBI agent (Beau Bridges) and a detective (Bubba Smith) tie ghetto drugs and mayhem to a colonel's (Lloyd Bridges) white supremacists. (Action) - 1987

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Winds of Autumn
screenpixwesterns.us.description: An 11-year-old Quaker boy sets out across the grasslands of 1880s Montana to avenge his family's deaths. (Western) - 1976

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Kentuckian
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Upstanding widower "Big Eli" Wakefield (Burt Lancaster) decides to move from Kentucky further west to Texas. He undertakes the journey with just his young son "Little Eli" (Donald MacDonald), but en route they pick up friends like indentured servant Hannah (Dianne Foster) and schoolmarm Susie (Diana Lynn), a potential love interest. This motley crew's path is difficult, and they face many obstacles, not the least of which is nasty frontiersman Stan Bodine (Walter Matthau). (Western, Drama) - 1955

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The King and Four Queens
screenpixwesterns.us.description: The four McDade brothers stage a successful heist -- except that three of them are killed. When their wives and mother learn that only one of the young men survived with the loot, they are eager to find out which one. Slick traveler Dan Kehoe catches wind of this strange situation and decides to charm the women in hopes of eventually enjoying the spoils. Before long, however, the lonely females begin competing for Dan, disintegrating into a cut-throat battle royal for his heart. (Western, Comedy, Adventure, Drama) - 1956

skycinemafamily.uk.description: Bitten by a radioactive spider, teenager Miles Morales suddenly develops mysterious powers that transform him into Spider-Man. He must now use his newfound skills to battle the evil Kingpin, a hulking madman who can open portals to other universes.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: Chipwrecked
skycinemafamily.uk.description: On a cruise, the Chipmunks and the Chipettes go overboard and are washed up on an island. They hope they will be rescued soon.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Road Chip
skycinemafamily.uk.description: The Chipmunks believe that Dave plans to propose to his new girlfriend in Miami and dump them. They have three days to get to him and save themselves not only from losing Dave but also from gaining a terrible stepbrother.

showtime2.us.title: Godzilla
showtime2.us.description: Godzilla, King of the Monsters, arises to combat massive, malevolent foes that have been feeding on a nuclear plant's reactors and now threaten mankind with total annihilation. (Movies, Sci-Fi) - 2014

showtime2.us.title: Scream 4
showtime2.us.description: The Ghostface Killer returns with a vengeance when self-help author Sidney Prescott arrives in Woodsboro on the last stop of her book tour. (Movies, Horror) - 2011

showtime2.us.title: Nightwatch
showtime2.us.description: A police inspector (Nick Nolte) suspects a law student (Ewan McGregor) or his friend (Josh Brolin) of serial killings and eerie events at the city morgue. (Movies, Horror) - 1998

starzcinema.us.title: Krystal
starzcinema.us.description: A sheltered young man joins Alcoholics Anonymous to get closer to the woman of his dreams, a former hooker and stripper named Krystal. (Comedy drama) - 2017

starzcinema.us.title: Twice Born
starzcinema.us.description: A mother brings her teenage son to Sarajevo to see where his father died in the war. (Drama) - 2012

starzcinema.us.title: Friend Request
starzcinema.us.description: Laura is a popular college student who graciously accepts an online friend request from Marina, a young social outcast. To everyone's shock, Marina takes her own life after Laura decides to unfriend her. Soon, a disturbing and mysterious video appears on Laura's profile and her contacts slowly dwindle. When her friends suddenly begin to die one by one, the frightened young woman must figure out a way to stop the carnage before it's too late. (Horror, Thriller) - 2016

starzinblack.us.title: Boomerang
starzinblack.us.description: A cocky ad executive, Marcus (Eddie Murphy) has a reputation as a ladies' man. However, Marcus gets a taste of his own medicine when a merger finds him working under the beautiful Jacqueline (Robin Givens), who has a similarly cavalier attitude about romance. Marcus and Jacqueline become involved, but he is put off by her noncommittal approach to their relationship. Meanwhile, Marcus also begins to develop feelings for the pretty Angela (Halle Berry), who is more thoughtful than Jacqueline. (Romantic comedy) - 1992

starzinblack.us.title: Blowback
starzinblack.us.description: A policeman (Mario Van Peebles) learns that the CIA saved a deranged killer from execution to use as a government assassin. (Action) - 1999

starzinblack.us.title: Idlewild
starzinblack.us.description: A reticent piano player, named Percival (André Benjamin), along with Rooster (Antwan A. Patton), his flamboyant lead performer and manager, struggle to keep their speakeasy, in the Prohibition-era South, out of the hands of gangsters who want to take it over. (Drama, Musical) - 2006

starzcomedy.us.title: The Wood
starzcomedy.us.description: Three old friends -- Mike (Omar Epps), Roland (Taye Diggs) and Slim (Richard T. Jones) -- recount memories of their shared childhood in Inglewood, Calif., as they prepare for Roland's wedding to his fiancée, Lisa (LisaRaye). When the groom goes missing without a word, Mike and Slim struggle to find their nervous friend and return him to his impatient bride before the wedding begins. Along the way, they continue to swap stories about lessons learned during their awkward teenage years. (Drama) - 1999

starzcomedy.us.title: Coming Soon
starzcomedy.us.description: Privileged teenage friends Jenny (Gaby Hoffmann), Nell (Tricia Vessey) and Stream (Bonnie Root) spend their senior year on a quest to rid Stream of her virginity. However, Stream wants more than just her first sexual experience. She wants to have an orgasm -- but achieving this proves problematic, as the boys she meets are hardly sensitive enough to provide her the release she seeks. When it becomes clear that Nell and Jenny have never experienced an orgasm either, all three set out to get one. (Romantic comedy, LGBTQ) - 1999

starzcomedy.us.title: Paul Blart: Mall Cop
starzcomedy.us.description: A single suburban father works at a mall as a security guard to make ends meet. He takes his job very seriously, even though most of his colleagues and customers don't. As the holidays approach, Paul gets his moment to shine when Santa's little helpers shut the mall down and take hostages, including his daughter and girlfriend. He realizes no one knows the place better than he does, and he mounts his trusty steed, a Segway, and goes to the rescue. (Comedy, Action, Adventure) - 2009

starzencorewesterns.us.title: Sitting Bull

Many die, but when he helps Sitting Bull survive, Parrish is charged with crimes against the government, and he will be executed unless Grant steps in. (Western) - 1954

He knows that revenge can only be attained by infiltrating Cutting's inner circle. Amsterdam's journey becomes a fight for personal survival and to find a place for the Irish people in the 1860's New York. (Historical drama, Crime drama) - 2002
